name: 通过 SAP Ariba Sourcing 的寻源 (4BL)
description_en_html:
Overview

Connect your SAP S/4HANA digital core for Sourcing and Procurement to the Ariba Network and SAP Ariba Sourcing. This provides access to intuitive RFX tools (for requests for information, requests for proposals, and reverse auctions), connections to more than two million companies, quick and easy supplier discovery, and automated and adjustable negotiation procedures.

Ensure event success by using the SAP Ariba Sourcing support desk and event-day management assistance. Evaluate the total cost impact of sourcing decisions. Reduce the amount of time and effort spent on administrative tasks. Handy wizards and tools help you launch events, collaborate, and negotiate. With the most suppliers from which to choose, and up-to-date profiles, ratings, and assessments, you can easily develop a large supply base and back-up sources, reducing supplier risks. Once you subscribe to SAP Ariba Sourcing, you can simply activate this scope item with guided configuration.

Note: This scope item uses SAP Ariba Cloud Integration Gateway for the integration and covers the full functional scope of the Sourcing with SAP Ariba Sourcing (1A0) scope item.

Key Process Flow

  • Create a request for quotations (RFQ) for purchase requisitions from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition that don’t automatically find a single source of supply (purchaser)
  • Send the RFQ to the SAP Ariba Sourcing application; this triggers a sourcing request (purchaser)
  • Access your worklist and convert sourcing requests into sourcing projects (sourcing manager)
  • Monitor sourcing projects that result in (reverse) auctions, or requests for quotations, and provide these to suppliers on the Ariba Network (sourcing manager)
  • Monitor suppliers’ responses (sourcing manager)
  • Award one or more bids in SAP Ariba Sourcing (sourcing manager)
  • Send awarded bids automatically to SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition where forwarded bids, purchase orders, or operational contracts are created

Business Benefits

  • Enjoy fast time-to-value and low total-cost-of-ownership with cloud-based delivery
  • Improve project management and compliance with advanced, automated workflow and approval-routing
  • Integrate SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition to SAP Ariba Sourcing by simple activation
  • Simplify and accelerate your configuration by taking advantage of built-in SAP Best Practices
  • Get predictable results fast as these best practices guide you through the integration process step-by-step
description_zh_html:
概览

将面向寻源和采购的 SAP S/4HANA 数字核心连接到 Ariba Network 和 SAP Ariba Sourcing。这提供了对直观 RFX 工具的访问（针对信息请求、建议请求和反向竞价），连接到超过 200 万家公司，快速轻松地发现供应商，自动化协商过程并可进行调整。

通过使用 SAP Ariba Sourcing 支持台和事件日管理协助确保事件成功。评估寻源决策的总成本影响。减少在管理任务上花费的时间和精力。便捷的向导和工具可帮助您启动事件、协作和协商。借助大多数可供选择的供应商以及最新的概要、评级和评估，您可以轻松开发庞大的供应库和备份源，从而降低供应商风险。订阅 SAP Ariba Sourcing 后，只需通过引导式配置即可激活此范围项目。

注意：此范围项目使用 SAP Ariba Cloud Integration Gateway 进行集成，并涵盖通过 SAP Ariba Sourcing 的寻源 (1A0) 范围项目的完整功能范围。

关键流程流

  • 为 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 中无法自动找到单一货源（采购员）的采购申请创建报价请求 (RFQ)
  • 将 RFQ 发送到 SAP Ariba Sourcing 应用程序；这会触发寻源请求（采购员）
  • 访问您的工作清单并将寻源请求转换为寻源项目（寻源经理）
  • 监控产生（反向）竞标或报价请求的寻源项目，并将其提供给 Ariba Network 上的供应商（寻源经理）
  • 监控供应商的响应（寻源经理）
  • 在 SAP Ariba Sourcing 中授标一个或多个投标（寻源经理）
  • 将中标自动发送到 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition，在其中创建转发的投标、采购订单或运营合同

业务优势

  • 通过基于云的交付快速实现价值并降低总拥有成本
  • 利用高级自动化工作流和审批路由，加强项目管理，提高合规性
  • 通过简单激活将 SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition 集成到 SAP Ariba Sourcing
  • 利用内置 SAP Best Practices 简化并加速配置
  • 快速获得可预测的结果，因为这些最佳实践将指导您逐步完成集成流程
